purpose: A row or column of buttons that switches between sibling views or routes of a page; exactly one item is selected.

notFor.case: Panels that swap in place under the tabs (usage points to Tabs, which is not an Escala component).
Two to five exclusive options of the same data, such as Day / Week / Month.
Top-level destinations of a mobile app.
Links in a header or navbar.

Default.visual: A track in Border/subtle, Stroke/divider thick under (horizontal-line) or beside (vertical-line) the items; the selected item carries the selection.

a11y.keyboard: Each item is its own tab stop; Space or Enter activates it.

openQuestions: Usage says to use Tabs when the panels swap in place, but there is no Tabs component in the index. Which component covers that case?
The menu moved from tablist / tab to group + aria-pressed (tab-menu-contract.md), so there is no arrow-key movement between items. Is that intended?
